ui_bugs.issue: On logout from dispatch user, 'Feature Not Activated. Subscribe for this feature. Contact your FLOWRA administrator to activate dashboard.' toast STILL appears momentarily before redirect. Fix did not work — page state reset is not happening before navigation/feature gate runs.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option> — originating from AppNavbar.js line 81 (FY selector). Pre-existing, flagged in iter 58.

action_items: FIX dispatch logout flash bug: in /app/frontend/src/App.js handleLogout, ensure the dispatch user's currentPage is reset to a feature they have access to (e.g. 'dispatch') BEFORE clearing token, OR clear token first and let the login redirect happen without rendering /dashboard route. Currently the route changes to /dashboard during the logout sequence and the FeatureGate triggers the 'Feature Not Activated' toast for the dashboard feature.
Optional: drop `<span>` wrapping inside `<option>` in AppNavbar.js FY selector (line ~81) to silence React hydration warning.

dispatch_logout_flash_bug.reproduction: 1. Login as dispatch@test.com/dispatch123. 2. Click Logout button. 3. Observe red/orange toast 'Feature Not Activated. Subscribe for this feature. Contact your FLOWRA administrator to activate dashboard.' for ~1s before login screen.
dispatch_logout_flash_bug.evidence: Captured DOM mutation during logout: ['Feature Not ActivatedSubscribe for this feature. Contact your FLOWRA administrator to activate dashboard.']. Final URL after logout: https://.../dashboard (NOT /login).
dispatch_logout_flash_bug.rca: App.js handleLogout was supposed to reset currentPage before clearing auth, but the dispatch role default page is being set to 'dashboard' (which dispatch role doesn't have feature access to), triggering the FeatureGate's toast. Likely the page state reset uses a default that assumes admin (dashboard) instead of role-specific (e.g. dispatch role -> dispatch page).
dispatch_logout_flash_bug.mitigation: In handleLogout: setCurrentPage(null) BEFORE clearing token, OR clear token+reset state in single setState call, OR have FeatureGate suppress toasts when token is null/clearing.
